sensor_placement.implication: When diagnosing BGP+VRF compounds: BGP truth is on station1 — bgp_flap_count SHOULD be present on station1 frames. station2 never has bgp_flap_count; if a blind ever labeled BGP on station2, that leg is structurally undetectable via bgp_flap_count. Current blinds place bgp_route_flap on station1 — sensor gap is NOT the explanation for station1 BGP misses; it WOULD be if we expected station2 to see BGP.
